actual_run_state.input_header: LW, ncol=1, nlay=45; overlap, seed, and ice flag come from the pinned input.
actual_run_state.n2_override: The captured result and sidecar come from the explicit CLI N2 override 0.7808, recorded in the run plan and argv. VMR_N2 is not a named section in the V10 text input.
actual_run_state.native_dry_mass: Input includes NATIVE_DRY_LAYER_MASS_KG_M2. Production converts native dry mass to molecules cm^-2 using Avogadro/(M_dry*10000); the input has 45 native layers for the 45-layer column.
actual_run_state.retained_output: Sidecar stores mapped SOURCE_LAYER/LEVEL/SURFACE and N2_OVERRIDE only; no pfrac, fmajor, jeta, jtemp, jpress, or tropo.
actual_run_state.trace_gases: V10 input includes VMR_CFC11/12/22/CCl4. Keep their recorded profiles in the gas descriptor.

coefficient_file_inventory.metadata_note: Rebuild loader reductions/remaps by named variables. Do not assume NetCDF absorber indices equal compressed runtime gas indices; resolve table species by gas name and preserve Fortran 1-based indexing.

equation_recipe: Read coefficient data by NetCDF dimension/variable names; reproduce loader gas-name reduction and key_species remapping by names.
Build VMR arrays from the V10 input and N2 CLI override. Build col_dry using the adapter native-mass formula; set col_gas(0)=col_dry and col_gas(gas)=VMR(gas)*col_dry.
For every layer reproduce jtemp/ftemp from TLAY and temp_ref; jpress/fpress from log(PLAY in adapter units) and press_ref_log; tropo from log(PLAY)>press_ref_trop_log.

For each runtime flavor and temperature plane reproduce eta using major-gas column amounts and vmr_ref ratios; then reproduce jeta, feta/fminor, and fmajor with the exact source index ordering and arithmetic.

For every band use the exact production atmosphere flavor selected at its first g-point, then call the translated interpolate3D_byflav formula over that band’s inclusive g-point range using scaling=[1,1], jeta, jtemp, and jpress+itropo.
Compare independently computed pfrac and pfrac-weighted raw Planck products with retained SOURCE_LAYER/LEVEL/SURFACE. Report pfrac versus the sidecar-inferred quotient separately.

gas_interpolation_formulae.atmosphere_selector: tropo=log(PLAY_adapter)>press_ref_trop_log; itropo=1 for true (lower-atmosphere table), 2 otherwise, matching merge(1,2,tropo).
gas_interpolation_formulae.eta_and_temperature_weights: For each flavor/layer and itemp=1,2: ratio=vmr_ref(itropo,g1,jtemp+itemp-1)/vmr_ref(itropo,g2,jtemp+itemp-1); colmix=colgas(g1)+ratio*colgas(g2); eta=colgas(g1)/colmix if colmix>2*tiny else 0.5; loceta=eta*(neta-1); jeta=min(int(loceta)+1,neta-1); feta=mod(loceta,1). ftemp_term is (1-ftemp) at itemp=1, ftemp at itemp=2; fminor(1,itemp)=(1-feta)*ftemp_term, fminor(2,itemp)=feta*ftemp_term.
gas_interpolation_formulae.float_and_index_policy: Translate Fortran INT truncation, CLIP bounds, MOD behavior for nonnegative loceta, branch conditions, and one-based table indexing exactly. Preserve production expression ordering; do not use a generic library interpolator without validating its index semantics.
gas_interpolation_formulae.fraction_interpolation: For each output gpt, sum the 8 pfracin corners for temp plane 1 weighted by fmajor(:,:,1), then multiply by scaling(1)=1; add the 8 corners at jtemp+1 and eta jeta(2) weighted by fmajor(:,:,2), times scaling(2)=1. Pressure corners are jpress+itropo-1 and jpress+itropo.
gas_interpolation_formulae.major_weights: fmajor(eta_index,pressure_index,temp_plane)=fminor(eta_index,temp_plane)*(1-fpress) for lower pressure index 1, and fminor*fpress for upper pressure index 2.

production_dependency_graph.required: Captured H2O/CO2/O3/N2O/CH4/O2/CFC VMRs, CLI N2=0.7808, PLAY/PLEV/TLAY, native dry mass, dry molecular weight and Avogadro. The adapter sets gases into ty_gas_concs and passes col_dry to gas_optics.

Available gas-name list (includes N2 for this run), source gas_names, key_species, and bnd_limits_gpt. Map species by name, reduce key_species, build unique flavors, then construct per-g-point lower/upper atmosphere flavor map.

PLAY converted as in adapter, TLAY, all runtime VMRs and col_dry-derived col_gas; coefficient press_ref_log, temp_ref, press_ref_log_delta, temp_ref_delta, press_ref_trop_log, vmr_ref and mapped flavor pairs. Recompute jtemp/jpress/tropo/jeta/fmajor in source order.

plank_fraction, band start/end g-point bounds, and computed tropo/fmajor/jeta/jtemp/jpress. Production picks iflav=gpoint_flavor(itropo,gptS) once per band and passes scaling=[1,1], inclusive band g-point bounds, jeta, jtemp, and jpress+itropo to interpolate3D_byflav.

Raw band Planck values from production totplnk interpolation plus independently computed layer pfrac. Compare their product with SOURCE_LAYER; for SOURCE_LEVEL use first/last layer pfrac at boundaries and sqrt(pfrac(k-1)*pfrac(k)) at interior levels; surface uses source sfc_lay pfrac.

purpose: Design an independent, source-faithful calculation of production GP Planck fraction pfrac for the retained single-column 45-layer BON LW state. Compute it from the pinned input and coefficient fraction table, never from SOURCE_LAYER/raw Planck.

python_reconstruction_assessment.basis: All needed numeric profile state is in the pinned V10 input plus the recorded N2 override; coefficients expose plank_fraction, gas reference axes, gas names, key species, and band-to-g-point mapping; production source defines deterministic interpolation equations.
python_reconstruction_assessment.independence_rule: Do not define reconstructed pfrac as SOURCE_LAYER/raw_band_planck. That quotient may be reported only as a secondary diagnostic against an independently computed pfrac.
python_reconstruction_assessment.not_proven_bitwise: No production pfrac array is retained. Python float arithmetic/libm may differ in final bits from compiled Fortran wp and operation order. Report reconstruction precision and mapped-source residuals; do not claim bitwise production equality without direct evidence.
